title: Death Sword
description: A custom sword which has two abilities, left click to teleport and sneak left click to send wave of slashs
body: A sword which was the sword of death dealer and it's name is death sword. it can be crafted with 1 nether star 1 blaze rod and 5 netherite ingot. this sword has two abilities first when you left click it teleports you and when sneaking+left clicking sends a wave of slashs.
